dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Haha, thanks for looking out for my daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: She can be quite headstrong. Only good old Ganyu... I mean, Ms. Ganyu, can get through to her.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: But ever since that previous incident, she seems to have become more receptive to my advice...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: ...Speaking of which, you're quite the cunning player yourself, hmm?
